description:
COMMUNITY EYE CAMP — BRIEF REPORT
To tackle avoidable vision impairment and bring quality eye care directly to the grassroots level, a focused Community Eye Check-Up Camp was organized.
* Total Patients Screened: 134
* Reading Glasses Distributed: 83
* Cataracts Identified: 7 (referred for further surgical treatment)
Key Outcome: Beyond immediate sight restoration through 83 pairs of spectacles, the early detection of 7 cataract cases ensures timely medical intervention to prevent blindness and enhance everyday independence.
